notes.title: The Mechanoids are back!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6051550/feaf862bf1f0024d50de28328c06c98cece9fdda.png[/img]

Twelve years after the A.I.M. II: Clan Wars release, the Mechanoids are back as the franchise’s scenario writer and leading game designer, Bulat Dautov, is working on a sequel named A.I.M. 3: War Protocol.

SkyRiver Studios’ old team members, Bulat Dautov (now turned CEO), as well as composer and sound designer, Grigory Semyonov who authored, among others, the famous Space Rangers soundtrack, are back again working on the new game!

A.I.M. 3: War Protocol has been funded exclusively by fans through Patreon. The game is currently in alpha phase with the release planned for 2022. Thanks to the support of our fans, a lot of content is now in release quality, making the alpha-to-release progress faster.

Don’t forget to add the game to your Steam wishlist and receive all future updates and news: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1171340

Learn more at https://aim3.ru and at https://skyriver.ru 

Support our project through Patreon - you can get access to certain perks and the whole development history, lore, and other materials: https://www.patreon.com/mechanoids
